name: Pi coding agent pulls a 180 and adds MCP support
description: Nonetheless, Pi has gained some features. These include Codemode, a harness-side sandbox that helps agents issue tool calls, with support for MCP, decision models, and image models; extension support for virtual models; deferred tool loading; cache warming for Anthropic models; mid-conversation system messages; a new TUI theme; and full-screen mode by default.
